C-34.Name: Mermaid diagram viewer: fullscreen pan/zoom, hover toolbar, copy/export, resilient rendering
C-34.Summary: Diagrams cannot be enlarged: the SVG is squeezed to the text column (width:100% + mermaid useMaxWidth) and any click opens the source. Research (docs/research/mermaid-ux-2026-10-14.md) recommends a hover toolbar plus a fullscreen overlay with free pan/zoom (@panzoom/panzoom, MIT, ~3.7 KB), copy/export SVG/PNG, keep-last-good rendering with the mermaid error text, render cache, theme from CSS variables.

Problem.Description: User report 2026-10-14: «отвратительно работаем с мермейд — ни увеличить ничего».

Goals.R-1: P0: fullscreen overlay (hover ⤢, Cmd+click, Space): pinch, Cmd+wheel, +/−/0/1, drag pan, Esc; focus trap.
Goals.R-2: P0: hover toolbar per diagram (expand, fit/100%, copy SVG, copy PNG, edit); a plain click still edits.
Goals.R-3: P0: keep the last good render and show the mermaid error under it. Size decision (user 2026-10-15, replaces the R2.1 natural-size default): wide diagrams fit the text column (useMaxWidth:true); natural size lives in the fullscreen block viewer, which opens fitted and centred.
Goals.R-4: P1: inline Cmd+wheel/pinch zoom with per-diagram state; export via save dialog; base theme fed from Mark CSS variables. (The SVG cache keyed by code+theme hash and the 250 ms debounce moved into R2.1 on 2026-10-15.)
Goals.R-5: P2: open in own window, drag-resize inline height, live split edit in fullscreen, idle/off-thread render for large diagrams, accTitle/accDescr a11y, dark diagrams in HTML/PDF export.

R2.1.Title: Render pipeline: cache, keep-last-good, error text, debounce, natural size

R2.2.Title: Toolbar + fullscreen overlay with @panzoom/panzoom + shortcuts
R2.2.Acceptance: Hover toolbar (expand, fit/100%, edit) appears on pointer hover and keyboard focus, never on a plain click; a plain click still opens the source. Overlay opens from ⤢, Cmd+click and Space on a focused diagram; pinch, Cmd+wheel, +/−/0/1, drag pan; Esc and the close button restore focus to the diagram; focus is trapped inside the overlay. Overlay shows the cached SVG (no re-render). New dependency @panzoom/panzoom pinned with its licence recorded; no new IPC permissions. e2e: open, zoom in, pan, Esc (Chromium + WebKit).

R2.3.Title: Copy/export SVG/PNG (style re-inlined, htmlLabels:false for canvas)
R2.3.Acceptance: Copy SVG puts a standalone SVG (hoisted style re-inlined) on the clipboard; Copy PNG rasterises at 2× via canvas without a tainted-canvas error (htmlLabels:false render used for raster); export uses the existing save dialog. Verified by pasting into another app in the real build.

R2.4.Title: P1/P2 items
R2.4.Acceptance: Split into separate approvals per item when picked up; inline zoom state is per diagram and survives re-render from the cache.

C-34.Dependencies: None (can run in parallel with C-35). R2.2 builds the fullscreen overlay as a shared block viewer that C-39 T2 reuses for tables.

Constraints.Constraint: No new IPC permissions; works under the WKWebView CSP (styles moved out of the SVG); a plain click keeps opening the source.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A wide flowchart opens fullscreen and zooms with trackpad pinch in the real app; copy SVG/PNG pastes into another app; a syntax error keeps the previous diagram visible with the error message.

AffectedAreas.M-011: muya renderMermaid pipeline, clickEvent routing, new diagram viewer

C-34.VerificationIntent: vitest units, Playwright e2e (open, zoom, Esc), live WKWebView pinch check.
